answer_card.title: Custom notification message
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `{{ }}` with dotted paths into the job:

```
{{ job_friendly_name }} {{ job.id }} ran on {{ job.execution_node }} in {{ job.elapsed }} seconds.
```

Other examples: `{{ job.summary_fields.inventory.name }}`, `{{ job.summary_fields.created_by.username }}`, `{{ job.status }}`.
